original:
Claim 4: The faces $F_{2}^{\prime}$ and $F_{4}^{\prime}$ are $\Delta_{v}$ -regular and the same holds for the line $L_{2}^{\prime}$ .

Proof of Claim 4. A direct computation give that the reduced equations are

 $\overline{Q|_{F_{4}^{\prime}}}=x^{qr-1}y\zeta_{q}^{-j}q\frac{r}{\pi^{r-1}}+x^{qr-r}y^{r}\zeta_{q}^{-rj}q+ux^{qr-1},$ 

 $\overline{Q|_{F_{2}^{\prime}}}=x^{qr-1}y\zeta_{q}^{-j}q\frac{r}{\pi^{r-1}}+x^{qr-r}y^{r}\zeta_{q}^{-rj}q-x^{qr+1}$ 

and

 $\overline{Q|_{L_{2}^{\prime}}}=q\zeta_{q}^{-j}\left(\frac{r}{\pi^{r-1}}1+T^{r-1}\zeta_{q}^{(1-r)j}\right).$ 

All of them are $\Delta_{v}$ -regular.
